label: Italian
source_guidance: Interpret omitted Italian subjects, tense and register. Distinguish grammatical gender from facts about characters.
target_guidance: Use natural Italian with consistent tense, gender/number agreement, articles and the register of forms of address.
punctuation_rule: Follow Italian punctuation and quotation conventions. Preserve accents, apostrophes and symbol pairing.
title_rule: Use conventional Italian titles and section labels.
term_guidance: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
